# Getting help

1. **The [README](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-USB-2-ETH0#readme)** covers installing, every command and option, choosing an adapter, troubleshooting and an FAQ.
2. **Check the TV first.**  The TV app's status screen, or `sh LG-USB-2-ETH0.sh status`, is read-only and says what it found and what to do next.
3. **A question or setup help?**  Ask in [Discussions > Q&A](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-USB-2-ETH0/discussions/new?category=q-a).
4. **Found a bug?**  Open a [bug report](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-USB-2-ETH0/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml) with the output of `sh LG-USB-2-ETH0.sh report`.  MAC addresses are hidden.
5. **Tested it on your TV?**  Send a [compatibility report](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-USB-2-ETH0/issues/new?template=compatibility-report.yml), whether it worked or not.  In the TV app, Report for GitHub fills it in for you.
6. **An idea?**  Post it in [Discussions > Ideas](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-USB-2-ETH0/discussions/new?category=ideas).

Rooting the TV isn't covered here: see [cani.rootmy.tv](https://cani.rootmy.tv/) and the [webOS Homebrew project](https://www.webosbrew.org/).  Security problems go through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-USB-2-ETH0/security/advisories/new), never a public issue.
